title: Hospitalization review at registration (R1)

patient_mappings.typed_transform: absent_assessed iff L1-L5 explicitly negative current AND no recent behavior; plan_intent_or_recent_behavior iff L4/L5 current OR recent actual/aborted/interrupted attempt or preparatory acts (proposed windows: past-month ideation, past-3-month behavior, pending owner); ideation_without_plan iff L1-L3 current without above; else unknown_incomplete. Partial (started-but-incomplete) is required-missing, not unknown.
patient_mappings.time_window: current encounter; proposed C-SSRS windows pending owner
patient_mappings.missing_policy: partial_or_conflict -> needs_clarification (blocks); skipped not_assessed -> unknown_incomplete (permits inference with disclosure)

patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff current field present (with context recorded); absent_assessed iff current absent AND history absent-or-assessed; else unknown_incomplete. Never inferred from PANSS P7.
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent -> unknown_incomplete with disclosure until field is reviewed and collected

patient_mappings.typed_transform: adequate/limited per reviewed anchors (to be drafted); else unknown_incomplete.
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent -> unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected

patient_mappings.typed_transform: prior_hospitalization_or_relapse iff hospitalization present OR relapse in {chronic_symptoms, repeated_relapses, both}; no_prior_event iff hospitalization absent AND relapse neither_identified; else unknown_incomplete. Admission definition/lookback per Q5.

required_fields: absence of conflicting values for mapped nodes
applicability.unknown_policy: explicit unknown_incomplete states permit inference with disclosure; partial/conflicting required inputs yield needs_clarification and stop later questions; false gate does not occur (applies to all registration)

cpt_contract.row_order: child state fastest; last declared parent next; first parent slowest
cpt_contract.validation: one table per node in declared order; exact node/parent/state identity and order; no extra fields; finite numbers in [0,100]; each row sums to 100 within 1e-6; reject missing/duplicate/extra rows, strings/booleans/null, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong sums; never normalize/clip/repair

evidence_mappings.evidence: mapped state, including unknown_incomplete as an observed state
mapped state, including unknown_incomplete as an observed state

mapped state, including unknown_incomplete as an observed state

impossible_evidence_policy: fail with explicit error; never soften or approximate. All declared states (including unknown_incomplete) are possible, so impossibility arises only from schema violations.
reviewed_result_mapping: posterior branch rendered as review prompt only; maximum posterior is not a recommendation rule; deterministic urgent flag from saved inputs shown first and never waits for LLM; unknown_disclosure always appended; needs_clarification branch on required missing/conflict

context_output_resource_limits.note: Limits are proposed engineering ceilings for review; final values set after measuring admitted models per plan 8.3. Full-CPT payload must fit or admission is rejected; no silent truncation.

engine_configuration.elimination_order: deterministic pinned order with deterministic tie-breaking
engine_configuration.note: Pinned engine/runtime recorded at admission in S39; replay reads stored effective CPTs/evidence/query without provider calls.
